set: real clips, every window of every title all candidate lists have analysed
what_this_measures: each detector against the union of what the candidate lists proposed, not against ground truth. Nobody has labelled anything. A window is positive here because some detector proposed it, so this is an upper bound on recall and it is not comparable with the conformance recall.
wilson_note: reported as the optimistic bound, because windows in one title are not independent

iris_build.note: built against Homebrew's OpenCV and ffmpeg rather than the vcpkg versions upstream pins, because the Docker build could not be run on this machine. docs/DECISIONS.md carries the deviation and eval/baselines/iris/README.md says what it costs.

iris_over_the_whole_pool.warning_segments_are_not_flags: IRIS passes flashing between 2 and 3 Hz. Those frames are counted here so that 'IRIS flagged nothing' can be told apart from 'IRIS saw nothing'.
